title: Decky Direct Updater — Find, install & update Decky plugins
description: Find, install and update Decky plugins directly from their developers on GitHub. Simple installation for Steam Deck and SteamOS.
hero_intro: Find, install and update plugins without leaving Gaming Mode.
copy_success: Copied! Paste the installation URL into Decky.
copy_error: Select the installation URL and copy it manually.
updates_text: Install a plugin once. Direct Updater finds its GitHub source and checks for new stable versions—even if they are not in the Store. You choose when to update.
updates_full: View the full-size pending updates screenshot
updates_alt: The Updates tab showing pending updates for installed plugins, with current and new versions.
details_full: View the full-size plugin details screenshot
details_alt: Plugin details showing the installed version, latest release, GitHub source and Update button.
step1: Open Decky Settings → General and enable Developer Mode.
step2: In Decky Settings, open Developer and choose Install Plugin from URL.
step2_confirm: Paste the URL into Decky, select Install and confirm.
step3: Open Direct Updater from the Decky menu. It also checks for its own updates.
zip_after: and use Decky's Install Plugin from ZIP File option.
find_text: Found a plugin on YouTube, Reddit or Discord? Search its name, check the author, and install it with your controller without leaving Gaming Mode.
trust: An independent project. GitHub releases may not have Decky Store review. Install from developers you trust. Plugins need a compatible release ZIP.
developers_text: Publish releases on GitHub? Recommend Direct Updater so your users can find updates, without building and maintaining your own updater.
